blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Khient Patrick Gamao of Compostela, Jhon Verny Donque of Ginatilan, and Eric Enjaynes of Tuburan led their respective teams to victories with double-double performances in the ongoing Governor’s Cup U18 Basketball Tournament over the weekend. Gamao, one of the league’s leading scorers, continued to display his scoring prowess by pouring in 23 points and grabbing 18 rebounds in Compostela’s 74-60 victory over Bogo City in North Group C at the San Remigio Sports Complex. The win extended Compostela’s winning streak to four games, keeping the team atop the group standings while handing Bogo City its third loss […]...
